verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents a Searches Archive API for retrieving your past search results (serpapi-docs-14), and results come in open formats: JSON, raw HTML, or Markdown (serpapi-docs-3, serpapi-docs-38). That is only a thin, indirect route to getting your data out: the archive is mentioned only for collecting async searches, and there is no documented bulk or account-wide export or offboarding path. missing for 10: documented bulk export of all account data and search history, retention guarantees for archived searches, an explicit data-portability or account-deletion process, independent corroboration.
